65290f395ae2ae97b80fdf2d Description: The MCX SPEAR is a multi-caliber assault rifle designed and manufactured by SIG Sauer based on the MCX assault rifle. Primarily chambered in the new 6.8x51mm (.277 FURY) ammunition but with a simple barrel change can also accept 6.5 Creedmoor and .308 Remington. Designed specifically for the US Military to replace the M4 carbine.
6529119424cbe3c74a05e5bb Description: A standard-issue upper receiver for the MCX-SPEAR assault rifle. Equipped with a mount for attaching additional devices. Manufactured by SIG Sauer.
